verdict.rationale: Mem0 offers a keyless CLI (mem0 --help/init/add/search with a --json agent mode), a pip/npm-installable SDK usable in scripts with no dashboard interaction, a REST/OpenAPI-documented API, and a self-hosted Docker/OSS option, all of which support headless CI/automation use. Runtime probes confirm the CLI and SDK work non-interactively and an agent-signup flow exists for autonomous key provisioning. missing for 10: no explicit CI pipeline example (e.g., GitHub Actions) or independent third-party confirmation of headless CI usage beyond vendor docs and probes.
